scripts.radio:
Welcome to Kenya on Record, your weekly check on public accountability and government services. I’m your host, and today we are looking at a major development from the Kenya Revenue Authority. 

KRA has announced a massive waiver—shikilia hapo—si habari ndogo. Shilingi bilioni sitini na nne ($64 billion shillings) zimesamehewa. This waiver affects nearly one million taxpayers, including both individuals and businesses who have been carrying the heavy burden of accumulated penalties and interest.

Now, let’s break this down. The tax amnesty framework is designed to give compliant and struggling taxpayers a clean slate. If you have been hiding from KRA because of accrued penalties from past years, this is your window to regularize your tax status without the crushing weight of historical fines. However, and this is very important, a waiver on penalties does *not* mean the principal tax is gone. You still have to pay the actual tax principal owed.

Citizens, this is the time to check your iTax profiles. Don't wait until the last minute. Talk to a certified tax expert or visit your nearest Huduma Centre or KRA office to understand how this waiver applies to your specific ledger.

***

*Kifupi cha Habari: Mamlaka ya Ushuru nchini, KRA, imesamehe adhabu na riba za ushuru za thamani ya Shilingi bilioni 64 kwa walipa ushuru karibu milioni moja. Hii ni fursa ya kusafisha akaunti yako ya iTax, lakini kumbuka kodi ya msingi bado inafaa kulipwa. Tembelea afisi za KRA au tovuti yao kujua jinsi ya kunufaika na msamaha huu.*
scripts.voice_note: Mambo vipi mwananchi? Hii ni Kenya on Record. Siku hizi mambo ni safi upande wa KRA kama uko na mzigo wa adhabu za nyuma. Mamlaka imetangaza kusamehe Shilingi bilioni sitini na nne za penalties kwa walipa ushuru karibu milioni moja! Sasa, hii haimaanishi ushuru wenyewe umefutwa—principal tax bado utalipa. Lakini ile adhabu ya kuchelewa imewekwa kando ili ukamilishe mambo yako bila presha. Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya iTax leo, angalia hali yako, na utumie hii nafasi kusafisha ledger yako kabla muda haujaisha. Usiseme hukusikia!
scripts.sms: KRA imesamehe Sh64bn za adhabu kwa walipa ushuru karibu milioni 1. Ingia iTax usafishe akaunti yako leo. Kumbuka kodi ya msingi bado inalipwa. #KenyaOnRecord
scripts.reels:
[Visual: Clean, professional graphic showing 'KRA: Sh64 Billion Penalties Waived' alongside a smartphone screen displaying an iTax profile.]

[Audio - confident, measured Kenyan English]: 
Si habari ndogo. KRA has just waved away sixty-four billion shillings in penalties for nearly one million taxpayers. 

If accumulated fines have kept you locked out of compliance, your clean slate is here. But remember—this is a waiver on penalties, not the principal tax. 

Log onto iTax today, check your ledger, and get right with the system. 

Kenya on Record. Know the facts, hold them to account.
